headline: Tyreek Hill found liable for 2 of 10 counts in battery trial; wife awarded $500K
summary: A Miami jury returned a mixed verdict in the assault and battery civil trial against Tyreek Hill, finding the former NFL receiver liable for two counts of battery but not liable for the eight other claims made by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro.

headline: Niners LB Dre Greenlaw's appeal of suspension rejected, will sit vs. Commanders
summary: Niners linebacker Dre Greenlaw will serve his one-game suspension in Monday night's game against the Commanders after the NFL denied his appeal Tuesday.

headline: NFL suspends Rams' Alaric Jackson for two games after punch
summary: The NFL on Tuesday suspended Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson for two games without pay after he punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb following Monday night's game in Los Angeles.

headline: Saints owner Gayle Benson rips 1-4 start, says fans 'deserve better'
summary: Saints owner Gayle Benson called out several members of the organization amid the team's 1-4 start and said that fans are "right to expect more than we have delivered."

headline: Bears DE Montez Sweat suspended two games for violating NFL's PED policy
summary: The NFL has issued a two-game suspension to Bears defensive end Montez Sweat for violating the league's policy on performance-enhancing substances.

headline: Micah Parsons: 'Jayden Daniels probably cost my man Dan Quinn his job'
summary: Micah Parsons said on his podcast that Jayden Daniels' mistake at the end of overtime Sunday will probably end up getting Commanders coach Dan Quinn fired.
